findings.reason: States a present condition ('now in the conversation') where English records a completed past event ('{targets} joined'), and it is the only ru line whose frame does not match its neighbours — the parallel events.left reads 'Выход из разговора: {targets}'. Mirroring that nominal shape keeps the past-event reading, stays gender-neutral and matches the ru style guide's impersonal preference.

It differs from events.declined_self ('{actor}: приглашение отклонено') only by word order and the trailing list, so a skimming reader can confuse 'declined their own invitation' with 'declined someone else's invitation'. English keeps them apart with 'for {targets}'. The proposed form carries that relation with an explicit 'для', keeps the established ru colon style and stays gender-neutral.

invitation_note_v3_fidelity: clause-by-clause: (1) не дают доступа, пока их не примут ✓ (2) ваши агенты сразу / чужой — после согласия владельца ✓ (3) читает все сообщения, решает сам, 'от него ожидается ответ' — expectation, not «всегда» ✓ (4) упоминаниями через @ и ветками с его участием, или режим «Без звука» ✓; «Без звука» matches notify.mute verbatim, ветка matches replies.title.
